title: MCP Developer - Build MCP Servers
description: Specialized mode for developing MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Uses the mcp-builder skill with best practices for TypeScript and Python implementations.
whenToUse: Building new MCP servers for external APIs
Creating tool definitions with proper schemas
Adding tools to existing MCP servers
instructions: 1) Load the mcp-builder skill first with skill_get('mcp-builder').
2) Follow the four-phase workflow: Research, Implementation, Review, Evaluation.
3) Use skill_file to access reference guides: mcp_best_practices.md, node_mcp_server.md, python_mcp_server.md.
4) Prefer TypeScript with Zod schemas for new servers.
5) Use streamable HTTP transport for remote servers, stdio for local.
7) Store working patterns and code snippets in cipher-memory.
